title: v3: LightGBM, terrain + geology
description: Gradient-boosted trees (LightGBM, the gbm_terrain recipe of the ML cross-validation) on the 13 v2 features plus valley-floor width, confinement, karst (bed and catchment share), rock age and GNS rock class and group. No coordinates, no OpenStreetMap features and no access. Trained like v2: the guide research sections (grade 2 and up) plus the reference rivers on the guides-v1 training rivers, every put-in and take-out including inferred ones, reaches of 2 km² or more; the same quarter of rivers is held out.
